response_blind_evidence.note: Sites are 100-km^2 grid cells over France. Tutorial reports 3450 sites and 23 annual primary periods (1994-2017) with four winter-month secondary occasions. This preflight does not treat a recorded nondetection as latent absence or a later detection as proven biological colonization.

strong_baseline_boundary: If later gates pass, the strong baseline must preserve the published process-aware advantage rather than compare EOG to a weak local-only model. Any occupied-neighbour feature must be temporally audited for heldout leakage before being admitted.
prospective_endpoint_boundary: Use a separately frozen recorded detection-state or detection-history predictive endpoint with observation semantics explicit. Do not relabel recorded nondetection-to-detection as true colonization without detection-model justification.
next_if_ready: Freeze exact geometry and predictor file identities at the pinned upstream commit, open only coordcells_wolf.rds, verify its object/schema identity, and run the response-blind structural-scale/adequacy gate before touching wolf_louvrier.rds.
